entries.en: You have been instructed to forge a bronze ingot with your newly acquired hammer. The requisite chunks of copper and tin ore can be purchased from Soemrwyb of the Armorers' Guild. Once you have synthesized a bronze ingot, deliver it to Forgemaster H'naanza.

entries.en:
Upon examining your bronze ingot, Guildmaster H'naanza is satisfied that the quality of your work is sufficient to meet the exacting standards of the Armorers' Guild. She instructs you to continue crafting bronze ingots until the process becomes second nature, at which point you are to return to the forge for your next lesson.

※The next armorer quest will be available from H'naanza upon reaching level 5.

entries.en: The key to making good bronze is judging the ratio of copper to tin. With too much tin, the alloy becomes harder but also more brittle. Not the sort of material you want protecting your vital organs.
entries.fr: Le truc avec le bronze, c'est d'obtenir les bonnes proporrrtions de cuivre et d'étain. Il suffit qu'il y ait trop d'étain, par exemple, pour que l'alliage ainsi forgé devienne trop fragile... et donc impropre à la fabrication d'armures.

甲冑の材料としては使えなくなる。

entries.en: Lest you forget, quality is a matter of life and death in our craft. That is why we teach our initiates the ideal metallurgic composition of every item we forge. Not that all are quick to learn. There are some who seem destined to produce mediocre results however painstakingly the processes are explained.
entries.fr: Bien sûr, tout ceci est parfaitement détaillé dans nos carnets, mais cela se joue vraiment à très peu de choses et il y a toujours des gens qui se trompent dans le dosage.

entries.en: But do not let this first success make you complacent. A single bad helm will lose you more trust than a hundred good ones will win, because bad armor means dead men. It is not enough that your work be good. It must needs be consistently good.

entries.fr: L'un des plus grands devoirs des armuriers de cette guilde est de toujours préserver la même qualité. Garde bien ça à l'esprit.

entries.en: And achieving that consistency requires discipline and long hours of crafting the same item over and over, again and again. For you, this means a mountain of bronze ingots.
